Class AuditDataset

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.core.atna.AuditDataset
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
FhirAuditDataset, MllpAuditDataset, WsAuditDataset
public abstract class AuditDataset extends Object implements Serializable
A generic data structure used to store information pieces needed for auditing.
Author:
Dmytro Rud

    • setRequestId

      public void setRequestId(String requestId, ParticipantObjectIdType requestIdType)
      Sets the correlation id along with the participant object ID type it is to be recorded under.
      Parameters:
      requestId - the correlation id
      requestIdType - how to record it, e.g. ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode.W3cTraceContext

    • getW3cTraceContextId

      @Deprecated(since="5.3", forRemoval=true) public String getW3cTraceContextId()
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      the trace context id was never anything but a correlation id read from an HTTP header, which is what getRequestId() is. Only the participant object it ends up in differs, and that is getRequestIdType() now.
      Returns:
      the correlation id if it is a W3C Trace Context one, null otherwise

    • setW3cTraceContextId

      @Deprecated(since="5.3", forRemoval=true) public void setW3cTraceContextId(String w3cTraceContextId)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      use setRequestId(String, ParticipantObjectIdType), with ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode.W3cTraceContext or, for the Swiss EPR, ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode.SwissW3cTraceContext. This one keeps setting the Swiss code, which is what it always did.
      Parameters:
      w3cTraceContextId - contents of a traceparent header

    • getRequestIdType

      public ParticipantObjectIdType getRequestIdType()
      Participant object ID type the correlation id is recorded under. The value is the same whichever it is; what differs is which profile asked for the correlation, and the profiles disagree on the code -- see ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode.XRequestId and ParticipantObjectIdTypeCode.W3cTraceContext.
